item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-06-27
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天 Nervos Talk 上 Spark Program 的 grant 申请非常活跃，共有 4 个新项目提交提案，涵盖 AI 辅助开发工具、AMM 交易构建器、交互式开发者教程基础设施以及 JoyID 故障排查工具。[S01, S02, S05, S08] 同时，社区成员继续就 NDAO 国库资金销毁方案的技术细节展开深入讨论。[S10, S11] ## 重点话题 **AI 辅助开发工具再添新提案**：George_Liam 提交了 "CCC Vibe-Coding Scaffold" 项目，这是一个专为 AI 辅助（"vibe-coded"）开发设计的 CCC 项目模板和测试框架，旨在让开发者更安全地用 AI 生成 CKB 代码。[S01] **CellScript AMM 交易构建器启动**：WuodOdhis 申请了基于 CellScript 的 AMM 交易构建器项目，ArthurZhang 回应称下周将有重大 CellScript 更新，并承诺协助解决开发中的阻塞问题。[S02, S03] **DOB Pattern Studio 首次亮相**：Tefro Labs 作为首次加入 CKB 生态的开发工作室，提交了面向 Spore/DOB 创作者的可视化模式构建器项目。[S06] **JoyID 故障排查工具提案**：Crackdevs 提出开发轻量级 CLI 和 npm 包，帮助开发者解读 JoyID/CCC 交易失败信息，降低调试门槛。[S08] **CKB Builder Lab 获委员会批准**：devnash...

item.title: CKB DevLaunch Kit (2 posts)
item.description: CKB DevLaunch Kit Summary CKB DevLaunch Kit is an open-source developer onboarding toolkit designed to reduce the learning curve for new builders entering the Nervos ecosystem. The project will provide ready-to-use templates, deployment scripts, sample dApps, and step-by-step tutorials for developers building on CKB. The objective is to accelerate ecosystem growth by enabling developers to launch proof-of-concepts within hours rather than days. Problem Statement While CKB offers powerful capabilities through its flexible architecture and Bitcoin-aligned design, new developers often struggle with: Environment setup Smart contract deployment workflows Understanding UTXO-based programming...

item.description: Hey all, I need to share a setback on the new iCKB CCC-native libraries. I was close to calling this work done, but we just got some bad news: The CCC UDT support that iCKB depends on is currently stale and I just got confirmation that it might very well be rewritten. Releasing now would risk giving developers something fragile. I’ll update again once the path is clear, Phroi
